title: British Airways Boeing 747-400 in D-Check
summary: An Engineering Giants documentary episode following a British Airways Boeing 747-400 through a D-check, the heaviest maintenance inspection, in Cardiff. The aircraft is stripped down and inspected nearly everywhere.
why: Recommended as a great look at how thoroughly airliners are inspected and rebuilt, and cited in aviation maintenance discussions.

quote.text: The BBC has a great documentary on a BA 747-400 D-check that has been posted on Youtube
